biography.plain_text: Kay Städing is the managing shareholder of HKL Baumaschinen, the Hamburg-based equipment rental, sales and service business co-founded by his father, Claus. He studied business administration and joined the company in 1990. His career has centred on developing the family enterprise, which expanded across Germany and into Poland and Austria.

long_biography.plain_text:
Kay Städing approached equipment rental through the practicalities of a customer's working day. At HKL Baumaschinen, he favoured depots that customers could reach without detours, with everyday tools and consumables available alongside machinery. Specialist centres supplied expertise in temporary buildings, access platforms and generators rather than offering the same range everywhere.

He also sought to reduce the number of people a customer needed to contact and make ordering more flexible. Although he backed digital processes, he expected personal conversations to remain part of the business. Outside HKL, he served for nearly eleven years on the supervisory board of Sparkasse zu Lübeck, leaving in 2022.
